 CBSE Date Sheet 2027 Class 10: LOC window closes, latest updates students and parents should know
 SECTIONS CBSE Date Sheet 2027 Class 10: LOC window closes, latest updates students and parents should know By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Oct 22, 2026, 08:43:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis CBSE Class 10 Board Exam Date Sheet 2027: CBSE has closed the regular LOC submission window for the 2027 Class 10 board exams on October 21, 2026. Check the latest updates on the CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027, expected release, exam schedule and official website.
 CBSE LOC window for 2027 board exams closed on October 21. Check the latest CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 updates, expected release and exam details. (AI generated image) 
 The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has closed the regular List of Candidates (LOC) submission window for the 2027 Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations, putting the focus on the next major update: the board exam date sheet. The deadline for schools to submit candidate details without a late fee ended on October 21, 2026. Schools that missed the deadline can submit the LOC with a late fee during the extended window from October 22 to October 30. The LOC process is important because schools submit students' details and subject choices for the upcoming examinations. With the regular submission deadline now over, students and parents are looking for an update on the CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 . The date sheet will help students plan their final revision, identify gaps between papers and prepare a subject-wise study schedule.
 CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027: Latest updates
Here are the key details students and parents should know:
 Date sheet release: Awaited as of October 22, 2026.
 Examination dates: The official subject-wise schedule has not yet been announced.
 Expected exam date: CBSE class 10 and 12 board exams are likely to take place in February, March 2027. 
 Official website: cbse.gov.in.
 Download format: Students can look for the official date sheet PDF once it is released.
 When will CBSE release the Class 10 Date Sheet 2027?
Reports suggest that the schedule could be published soon, but students should avoid treating any projected release date as official. The previous examination cycle offers a useful reference. CBSE published the date sheet for the 2026 board examinations on October 30, 2025. Once the date sheet is available, students will be able to check the dates for their respective subjects and plan their remaining preparation accordingly. 
 How to download CBSE Class 10 Date Sheet 2027 PDF
Once CBSE publishes the timetable, students can follow these steps to download it:
 Visit the official website, cbse.gov.in.
 Open the latest announcements or examination section.
 Look for the notification related to the Class 10 board examination date sheet for 2027.
 Click the relevant link to open the PDF.
 Check the subject names, examination dates and timings carefully.
 Download the document and save a copy for future reference.
 Students should use the official PDF rather than relying solely on screenshots or forwarded messages. If CBSE subsequently publishes a revised timetable, the latest official version should take precedence.
 Live Events
 What details will the CBSE date sheet contain?
The timetable is expected to provide the information students need to prepare for their examinations. This generally includes:
 Subject names and examination dates.
 Subject codes.
 Examination timings.
 Important instructions for candidates.
 Details relevant to the conduct of the examinations, as specified by CBSE.
 Students should check every subject they have registered for, including language papers, optional subjects and vocational courses where applicable. Looking only at the dates for Mathematics, Science, English and Social Science could lead to confusion if another paper falls on a different day.
 How should students prepare before the date sheet is released?
Waiting for the timetable can be stressful, particularly for students who want to know exactly how much time they will have between examinations. However, the absence of a confirmed schedule should not delay preparation.
 1. Complete the syllabus first: Students should identify unfinished chapters and prioritise topics that require more time. Leaving several chapters for the final weeks can make revision difficult.
 2. Practise official sample papers: CBSE's academic website, cbseacademic.nic.in, provides curriculum-related resources and sample question papers. Solving them under timed conditions can help students understand the paper format and improve time management.
 3. Revise regularly: Instead of postponing revision until the timetable arrives, students can set aside time each day for formulas, definitions, important concepts and previously studied chapters.
 4. Work on weak subjects: Students should review their school test results and identify where they are losing marks. Regular practice in these areas can be more useful than repeatedly studying chapters they already understand.
 5. Avoid unverified date sheets: Unofficial timetables can cause unnecessary anxiety. Students should confirm all dates through the board's website before making travel plans or changing their study schedule.
 What should parents know about CBSE Class 10 exams 2027?
Parents can help by ensuring that students have a realistic study plan, adequate rest and access to the materials they need. Repeatedly asking whether the date sheet has been released may increase pressure without helping preparation.
It is also worth checking registration details with the school. Students and parents should confirm that personal details and subject choices submitted for the board examinations are correct, and contact the school promptly if any discrepancy is identified.
